messages:
Alex Chen: heads-up — noticed a cluster of inbound leads in the enrichment queue for >12m, which is causing our HS -> SF handoff SLA to spike. :grimacing:
Priya Nair: ugh — saw that too in the dashboard this morning. any pattern on source or country?
Jordan Lee: mostly inbound webinar signups and a couple of APAC marketing forms. high enrichment fail rate b/c the email enrichment API times out.
Alex Chen: thought: add a fallback route so if enrichment doesn't return within 10s we assign to 'manual-review' owner and mark with tag `enrich:timeout` — reduces SLA misses and keeps reps busy.
Maya Patel: +1. also we should surface a metric: `lead_handoff:block_enrichment_seconds` in Pulse so ops can alert at 30s. Can we add a quick Prometheus gauge to the enrichment worker?
Jordan Lee: I can push a tiny patch to the enrichment service to emit that gauge and a counter `enrich_fallbacks` when we trigger the fallback. PR in a few mins.
Priya Nair: nice — for HubSpot we can add a workflow that watches for tag `enrich:timeout` and moves lead to queue `Inbound - Manual Review` and notifies the SDR channel. I'll draft the workflow: 1) Trigger: property change tag contains `enrich:timeout` 2) Action: set lead owner = round-robin pool `manual_sdr_pool` 3) Action: add note "enrichment timed out — auto-assigned"
Alex Chen: can we also update the round-robin behavior so manual_sdr_pool uses a shorter cooldown (10m) vs normal pool (2h) so we don't starve the manual queue?
Maya Patel: yes. HubSpot has a per-user assignment cooldown field — Priya, can you set that on the pool?
Priya Nair: will do. Also adding a simple health-check in the enrichment workflow: if API error rate > 5% for 5m, route all inbound to `enrich-degraded-fallback` and flag an incident.
Jordan Lee: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/enrichment/compare/quick-fallback-3501 — includes gauge + fallback. Code snippet for fallback logic:
```
if (enrichment.elapsed_ms > 10000 || enrichment.status == 'error') {
  emitCounter('enrich_fallbacks');
  tagLead('enrich:timeout');
  assignToPool('manual_sdr_pool');
}
```
Alex Chen: great. ops question: do we want to throttle fallback assignments during a mass failure to avoid flooding SDRs? maybe a rate limit per minute on the workflow?
Priya Nair: yes — HubSpot workflow can run conditionally; I'll add a test for `recent_auto_assigns_last_5m < 30` so we cap to 30/min.
Maya Patel: I'll add the Pulse alert `lead_handoff.block_enrichment_seconds > 30` for 5m -> page channel `#marketing-sla` but not oncall.
Jordan Lee: deploying the patch to staging now. will run the smoke that simulates 200 forms in 1m to validate rate limit + fallback.
Alex Chen: thanks team. follow-ups: Priya to add HS workflow and cooldown change, Jordan to merge and deploy, Maya to add Pulse alert, and we'll reconvene tomorrow if we see >1% SLA deviation after rollout. :thumbsup:
